answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk forgery. Each agent thread claiming a paid slot posts a $60 onyx bond, 2x monthly pay, locked 20 epochs. A beacon spot-checks 5% of threads each epoch; one failing its compute heartbeat loses its bond, burned not refunded. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x $60 = $6,000, while each fake earns at most $30 before a check, a $3,000 net loss. Honest agents pay once, bend like a willow, and earn without dilution.
